module.purpose: Provides React hydration strategies that defer hydration until a component becomes visible, while supporting optional prefetching and server-side readiness.
module.summary: This client-side hydration module implements visibility-gated React hydration using Suspense, promises, intersection observers, and strategy callbacks. It creates a gate that resolves immediately during server rendering and otherwise resolves when the observed marker enters the configured viewport threshold. Optional prefetch behavior runs independently before hydration, and cleanup functions disconnect observers when effects are removed.
module.businessContext: Supports performance-oriented progressive hydration for React applications. Failures can delay interactive content, cause hydration mismatches, or leave observers and prefetch work active unnecessarily.
classes: VisibleGate (~L13-17): Internal promise gate coordinating visibility-triggered hydration readiness
functions: HydrationBoundary (~L20-39): Suspends children until the visibility gate resolves
VisibleHydrate (~L42-97): Builds React markup and effects for visible hydration
visible (~L98-130): Creates viewport-observer hydration and prefetch strategy callbacks

preconditions: The function is invoked as a React function component during a valid render.
The this context provides a ReactHydrationStrategy with an optional _s scheduler.
postconditions: A visible hydration gate is initialized and retained for the component lifetime.
On the server, the gate is marked resolved immediately.
On the client, hydration scheduling is delegated to the strategy scheduler unless the gate has already resolved.
If preload is configured and prefetch is not a function, the prefetch scheduler is invoked with the marker element and preload value.
invariants: The gate object is created once per mounted component instance.
The gate's resolved flag changes from false to true only through its resolver.
The hydration scheduler is not requested after the gate is resolved.
Optional scheduler callbacks may return effect cleanup functions.
edgeCases: When running on the server, or when isServer is truthy, the gate resolves during initialization and the hydration scheduler is not subsequently requested.
When preload is absent, the prefetch scheduler is not invoked.
When prefetch is a function, the prefetch scheduler is not invoked by this unit.
When either scheduler is absent, the corresponding scheduling step is skipped without producing a fallback error.
When a scheduler returns a cleanup function, React uses that function as the effect cleanup.

detail.name: visible
detail.signature: export function visible(options?: VisibleHydrationOptions): ReactHydrationStrategy<'visible', true> & HydrationPrefetchStrategy<'visible'>
preconditions: If provided, options must conform to VisibleHydrationOptions.
postconditions: Returns an object implementing ReactHydrationStrategy<'visible', true> and HydrationPrefetchStrategy<'visible'>.
The returned strategy uses the configured or default root margin and threshold when observing an element.
invariants: The default root margin is '600px' when options.rootMargin is nullish.
The default intersection threshold is 0 when options.threshold is nullish.
For an observed element, the callback is invoked only after the first intersection entry is intersecting.
The observer is disconnected before the intersection callback is invoked.
edgeCases: When options is omitted, rootMargin defaults to '600px' and threshold defaults to 0.
When the strategy receives no element, it invokes the selected callback immediately and does not create an observer.
When the first intersection entry is not intersecting, the observer remains active and the callback is not invoked.
When the first intersection entry is intersecting, the observer is disconnected and the selected callback is invoked.
When prefetch is provided, it is selected as the callback; otherwise the visible gate's signal callback is selected.
stateMutations: Registers the target element with an IntersectionObserver.
Disconnects the IntersectionObserver after the first intersecting entry.
detail.ioFormatSpec: The returned strategy exposes an _s callback accepting an object with element, gate, and optional prefetch fields. For a non-null element, it constructs an IntersectionObserver using rootMargin and threshold, observes the element, and invokes the selected callback once the first entry is intersecting.
detail.summary: Creates a visible-element hydration strategy that triggers hydration when the target intersects the viewport. It supports configurable intersection root margin and threshold, and can invoke prefetching through the returned strategy.

specTests.then: The selected callback is invoked immediately, without requiring an IntersectionObserver.

specTests.then: The observer remains connected and the selected callback is not invoked.

specTests.when: The observer receives a first entry whose isIntersecting value is true.
specTests.then: The observer is disconnected and the selected callback is invoked.
